note: This package installs and runs from the profile plus a captured session snapshot of conol.ai. Auth is passkey-only via better-auth v1.6.16 (WebAuthn): no email/password, no Google OAuth. Cookie: __Secure-better-auth.session_token. Session check: GET /api/auth/get-session returns null when unauthed, session JSON when authed. The SPA app is fully client-rendered behind session -- capture once headed after passkey auth, then record the cookie set + app chunk URLs in state.json. Passkey registration is a browser-native ceremony (WebAuthn navigator.credentials.create) and cannot be scripted.
